params.name: time
params.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the historical snapshot. The time is truncated to the start of the UTC day.

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query portfolio history for.

items.docs: Retrieves historical portfolio snapshots for the specified address across chains, for the UTC day containing the given time. The response is keyed by chain, then by token pricing ID.

info.name: Get daily time series data for an address's token

params.name: pricingId
params.description: The CoinGecko pricing ID of the token to track.

items.docs: Returns daily snapshots (in UTC) of the specified address's holdings of a given token. The response is keyed by day (UTC timestamp), then by chain, then by token pricing ID.
